citations.claim: Level exceeds capacity while valve is fully open and no spill recorded
Valve saturated fully open but level still rising toward cap
Spilled total stays zero despite level exceeding capacity

counterfactual.change: Reduced mean inflow from 8 to 5, keeping all other params and steps identical, so max valve outflow (6) plus demand can balance inflow and level stays below cap

explanation: With inflow 8, demand 1 and max valve outflow 6, net inflow remains positive (~+1 plus noise) even with valve=1 fully open, so level climbs from ~38.4 at step 12 to ~39.07 at step 13 to ~38.58 at step 14 to 40.585 at step 15, exceeding capacity 40. Spill handling fails: spilled stays 0 instead of clamping level to capacity and accumulating excess, causing level_within_capacity violation.

violation.detail: The water level never exceeds the tank capacity.
